service.description: An employee files a confidential case with their employer: the subject, what happened, the day it happened and how they want to be contacted, under a current employment of their own (partyRelationshipId; the only one when empty). Its handlers are the employer's designated intake handlers (the PartySetting PeopleCaseIntake), each holding PEOPLE_CASE_HANDLE and working for the employer, never the employee; they are told on PeopleCaseUpdate, whose title names nothing. No triage notice, case profile or service-level clock follows (the Request rules leave the type alone). A retry with the same operationKey answers the case filed (created false). Refuses a caller with no current employment (NOT_EMPLOYED), an employment not theirs (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), no employment chosen of several (EMPLOYMENT_REQUIRED), no subject (SUBJECT_REQUIRED), a day in the future (DATE_INVALID) and an employer with no intake handler (NO_CASE_HANDLER).

The caller's confidential cases: those they filed and those they handle (an Assignee of the case holding PEOPLE_CASE_HANDLE), open (the default), closed or all, newest first, paged; requestId narrows to one. Each row: the reference, subject, state, the caller's part, the employer, the handlers, the day it was filed and, for a handler, who filed it. A manager, HR or anyone else reads none of them; a case not the caller's is not available (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE). canFile and employerOptions: whether the caller has a current employment to file under, and which. Refuses a call with no user (PERMISSION_DENIED) and a show that is not open, closed or all (SHOW_INVALID).

parameter.name: cases
parameter.description: requestId, referenceText, subject, statusId, stateText, stateColor, role (filer or handler), roleText, organizationText, handlersText, filedByText (a handler's), submittedDateText, open

actions.script: for (const key of Object.keys(found)) ec.context.put(key, found[key])

service.description: One confidential case for its people: what the employee wrote, the state, the employer, who filed it, its handlers and outcome note, the caller's part and revision; the moves the caller may make (a handler's start, resolve, close and reopen; the employee's withdraw); for a handler the tasks asked of others on it and the case handlers of the employer who could be added. Anyone else, a missing case alike, is refused RECORD_UNAVAILABLE.

actions.script: for (const key of Object.keys(found)) ec.context.put(key, found[key])

service.description: A move of a confidential case at the revision read: a handler's start (to In progress), resolve (Resolved, with an outcome note), close (closed without action, with a note) and reopen (a resolved case back to In progress); the employee's withdraw while it is open. Its people are told on PeopleCaseUpdate. Refuses anyone not on the case (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a move not theirs (PERMISSION_DENIED), one the state does not allow or not one (ACTION_INVALID) and a revision other than the one read (REVISION_CHANGED).

A handler of an open confidential case adds another case handler of the employer (PEOPLE_CASE_HANDLE, working for it, never the employee who filed it), who is told on PeopleCaseUpdate; or, with remove, takes a handler off, never the last. Refuses anyone but its handlers (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE, PERMISSION_DENIED), a party who may not handle it (HANDLER_INVALID), the last handler's removal (LAST_HANDLER), a closed case (CASE_CLOSED) and a revision other than the one read (REVISION_CHANGED).

A handler of an open confidential case asks someone for work on it: a task (its name the handler's words, a due day) assigned to that person and linked to the case (RequestWorkEffort). The task is protected: left out of the CalDAV Tasks collection and of every task list but its assignee's, and its assignee reads nothing of the case; they are told on PeopleTaskAssigned (who asked and when it is due). Its status never moves the case. Refuses anyone but its handlers (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE, PERMISSION_DENIED), a closed case (CASE_CLOSED), no name (NAME_REQUIRED) and no assignee (ASSIGNEE_REQUIRED).

Whether the caller is one of a confidential case's people (its files and notes, for get#RecordLinkInfo and RecordFiles): the employee who filed it or a handler; canEdit while it is open. Never refuses: a request that is not a case, or not the caller's, answers recordVisible false, and so does a call with no user.

Internal, for the record notices (mantle.party.CommunicationServices notify#RecordMention and notify#RecordFollowers): a note or message on a confidential case tells its people on PeopleCaseUpdate (no push, a title that names nothing) in place of the generic topics, which carry the record's name and the start of the text; nobody else is told. A request that is not a case tells no one.

The manual data service of the search documents MantleRequest and MantleCommunicationEvent: a confidential case's request, and a message or note filed on one, gain the field confidentialCase, which each document's post-query condition leaves out of the index, so no case text is searched. Any other document is unchanged.
